task:
Follow the implementation plan exactly: docs/plans/2026-07-10-notebooklm-first-artifact-slides-prompt-shaper.md

Goal: Add the smallest NotebookLM revival artifact - a pure deterministic generateSlidesPrompt function inside packages/witness-pipeline.

Key requirements from the plan and prior context:
- Create src/notebooklm/slides-prompt.ts and slides-prompt.test.ts
- Re-export from packages/witness-pipeline/src/index.ts (additive)
- generateSlidesPrompt(output: OrchestratorOutput, opts?: {language?: string, bridgeMandates?: string[]}): string
- Must inject: Language line, relationship_header when present (verbatim), 'Facts only. No prediction. No diagnosis...' guardrail sentence
- For solo paths: fall back to 'Solo Reading — non-predictive pattern witness'
- Support passing bridgeMandates (e.g. 'No investment or outcome guarantees') and include them
- Use TDD: write failing test, run to fail, implement, run to pass, small commits
- All changes additive; full test suite must stay green (currently ~88 tests)
- The output prompt should be a ready-to-paste NotebookLM slides prompt with structured 8-12 slide outline, citing passes when available

Do not touch any other features (no L4/L5 changes, no retrieval, no Rust, no Folio renderer).

After changes, run: pnpm --filter @noesis/witness-pipeline test
Report the final test count and that all pass.

Since this is a worktree task, produce the changes as a patch/diff in the run output or leave in the worktree.
